entities.name: István Lackfi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stephen II Lackfi was Ban of Croatia, Palatine of Hungary and the Voivode of Transylvania from the Lackfi family. He was murdered at the Bloody Sabor of Križevci by the followers of king Sigismund. His estates were confiscated by the crown and the bulk of it, in the region of Međimurje, sold to the king's father-in-law Hermann of Celje.
